system.description:
You become a beacon of cosmic order, banishing the forces of chaos and entropy.

For the spell’s duration, you are immune to all spells and magical effects from chaotic sources.

If your deity is @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.patrons-and-deities.Item.p91vJhT8FXvb2mLj]{Madeera the Covenant}, cast this spell with ADV.
